the loop

Five stages, executed in order, logged in full.

  1. 01

    Inspect

    Open the target, discover its contract, map reachable endpoints.

  2. 02

    Diagnose

    Probe live endpoints and isolate defects from real responses.

  3. 03

    Patch

    Record each defect with a concrete, reviewable remediation.

  4. 04

    Verify

    Retest the endpoint. Unverified patches never count as fixed.

  5. 05

    Report

    One audit trail per run: every probe, payload and verdict.
